summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the white-label Company Settings feature. All 5 backend tests pass (public GET, PUT auth matrix, persistence, regression). All frontend flows pass: Login defaults, admin edit + save w/ toast, sidebar+header branding propagation, print/PDF branding, teacher redirect from /settings/company, and full defaults restore. Regression: /r/admission still shows 9 records, dashboard OK. Final state = BIFD defaults (verified via GET /api/company-settings).
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx still hardcodes the copy 'One connected system for all 19 institute registers.' — the number is outdated (27 built-in registers per REGISTERS list + custom). Not part of white-label but worth surfacing.

server.py PUT /company-settings does not validate email/website format or logo size (frontend enforces 2MB); a malicious admin could push a huge base64 logo. Low risk since admin-only, but consider a server-side size cap.
company.js cache is module-scoped; on hard navigation from login (no auth) to app it re-fetches, which is fine. clearCompanyCache() is called on save — good.
seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily set company to 'Test Fashion Academy'/'TFA' during test then restored to BIFD defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is stable. Final DB state: company_settings = BIFD defaults, logo empty. Admission collection: 9 rows untouched. testsess_admin and testsess_teacher sessions exist in user_sessions and are valid 7 days.
